name: comp-330

frames.best_why: Frame 3 shows all three plan rows with Standard selected and the full feature list.

tagline: Plan chooser lists three tiers with radios and ticks what each gives.
summary: A trigger opens a tall narrow dialog listing three plans as radio rows with prices, a checked feature list below, and Change plan and Cancel buttons.
appearance: Closed, an outlined Change plan button. Open, a tall narrow dark dialog with a refresh icon, a title and grey subtitle, three bordered rows each holding a name, price and radio, the picked row tinted, then a six-line ticked feature list, a white Change plan and a ghost Cancel.
behaviour: Choosing a row moves the tint and fills its radio; Standard starts selected. Change plan does nothing, and Cancel, Escape or the X closes.
demo_content: Plans Essential at $4, Standard at $19 and Enterprise at $32 per member/month, with six feature lines.
use_when: An existing customer needs to switch tiers without leaving the app screen.
avoid_when: Prices, plan names and feature lines are fixed, and Change plan has no submit action.
customise: Plan names, prices, feature list and the default selection are hardcoded; the component takes no props.
weight_why: One dialog with a three-item radio group and a static list.

a11y.note: Plan rows are proper radios with descriptions, but each row removes its own outline and relies on the radio's focus ring.

issues: Change plan has no handler, so the selected plan is not applied.
Prices are fixed to monthly per-member billing with no interval switch.
polish_why: Clear plan chooser with a real selected state; the inert confirm is the only gap.
title: Change Plan Dialog
